heading.en: Ammoron succeeds Amalickiah as king of the Lamanites—Moroni, Teancum, and Lehi lead the Nephites in a victorious war against the Lamanites—The city of Mulek is retaken, and Jacob the Zoramite is slain. About 66–64 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua sui Amorona ia Amalekia i le avea ma tupu o sa Lamanā—Ua taitai e Moronae, Teanekuma, ma Liae, sa Nifaē i se taua manumalo e faasaga ia sa Lamanā—Ua toe maua mai le aai o Moleka, ma ua fasiotia Iakopo le sa Soramā. E tusa o le 66–64 T.L.M.
